label: Чувствовать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for чувствовать (to feel).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Чувствую' replaces the -ова- of the infinitive with -у-, giving the stem чувству-. 'Чувствовать себя' means to feel a certain way physically or emotionally.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Чувствуешь' keeps the present stem чувству- and adds -ешь. 'Холод' is the accusative object that is being sensed.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Чувствует' is the он-form ending in -ет on the stem чувству-. 'Сильную усталость' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Чувствуем' is the мы-form ending in -ем. 'Большую ответственность' is the accusative object naming the felt emotion.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Чувствуют' closes the present ladder with the -ют ending on чувству-. 'Опасность' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Чувствовал' is the masculine singular past, which restores the full -ова- of the infinitive. The imperfective stresses the ongoing sensation.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Чувствовала' adds the feminine -а ending. With 'себя' and the adverb 'одиноко' it describes a past emotional state.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Чувствовали' is the plural past ending in -и. 'Радость и счастье' are the accusative objects naming the emotions felt.

missions.phrase: Скоро ты будешь чувствовать себя сильнее.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Будешь чувствовать' joins 'будешь' with the infinitive, since чувствовать is imperfective. 'Себя сильнее' projects an improving future state.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. The impersonal 'важно' governs the bare infinitive чувствовать. 'Поддержку' is the accusative object of this abstract feeling phrase.
